text: Figure 3.30: Structure of Deliverable VFB System Deliverable VFB System Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Library::VFB::Work Products Brief Description Complete VFB view of a concrete system. Description Delivery of a VFB view of a concrete system. i.e. the top level composition and all nested compositions and components. This element is the basis for several extensions according to the scope of the VFB which can be an Overall System, a System Extract or an ECU Extract. This deliverable may contain variation points in its XML artifacts which need to be bound in later steps of the methodology. If such variation points are present, the delivered VFB system may optionally include PredeﬁnedVariants in order to predeﬁne variants for later selection and an Evaluated Variant Set.
